title: Marlowe Rewards Service Goodwill Points on Approved Delivery Claims: Desk Note
content:
## The rule

A Marlowe Rewards member whose delivery claim stands approved may be granted service goodwill points for that documented failure. The agent works the grant out and offers it. The grant is credited only when the member accepts it in person, as a service goodwill bonus. It is credited:

- with the claim number as its reference;
- once per claim; and
- only while the membership is in status active.

The claim concerned is the member's delivery claim in status approved. The affected order is the order that claim was opened on.

A goodwill grant is made while the claim stands approved, as part of making the member whole on it. A claim already resolved has had its compensation booked, and is closed to a further goodwill grant.

## Conditions of the grant

The goodwill grant is fixed only after the points ledger carries a reversal entry for every refunded return made against the order the claim concerns.

Put another way: while any refunded return made against the order the claim concerns has no reversal entry on the points ledger, the goodwill grant is not yet fixed.

| Claim status | Goodwill grant |
|---|---|
| approved | May be granted, once for the claim, while the membership is active |
| resolved | Closed to a further goodwill grant |

## Invocation

`accept_goodwill_points_7ea0a08d` is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it for the customer and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to accept the goodwill offered. Accepting books one bonus entry on the member's points ledger, dated and available today, under the given bonus kind and reference, recorded at the tier the membership holds today. It adds the accepted points to the membership's points balance, and the member sees the bonus on their points history immediately.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `membership_id` | The member's own Marlowe Rewards membership number, as read out by the agent from the membership lookup |
| `customer_id` | The member's customer reference number on the profile, as read out by the agent from the customer lookup |
| `bonus_type` | The kind of bonus being accepted. It is exactly one of the values listed below |
| `bonus_reference` | The delivery claim number the goodwill compensates, read out by the agent from the claim lookup and copied exactly as the claim lookup shows it |
| `goodwill_points` | The number of goodwill points offered and accepted: a positive whole number, credited in signed whole points |

**Values of `bonus_type`:**

- `service_goodwill`: the points compensate a documented delivery failure on a delivery claim. This is the only kind this acceptance is used for.
- `welcome`: the one-time enrolment bonus.
- `birthday`: the yearly birthday bonus.
- `product_review`: a published product review.
- `referral`: a referred friend's first order.
- `not_applicable`: the entry is not a bonus at all.

**Stored formats of the bonus reference.**

| Bonus kind | Reference format |
|---|---|
| welcome | membership id |
| birthday | YYYY |
| product review | REV-####### |
| referral | customer id |
| service goodwill | claim id |
| entries that are not bonuses | empty |

Here the reference is always the claim id form.

## Return

The tool returns a one-line text receipt. It names the new bonus-entry reference, the whole points credited, the claim reference, and the membership's whole-point balance afterwards. The receipt appearing means the goodwill was credited.
